# FxAI

> FxAI is a free iOS app (iPhone and iPad) that enhances photos with AI in one tap. It bundles four tools: Retouch (beautify portraits at Natural, Enhanced, or Studio strength), Restore (repair, unblur, and colorize old photos), Edit (change a photo by describing the edit in plain language), and Erase (brush away unwanted objects). Every result comes with a before/after slider. Free to try; FxAI Pro removes watermarks and limits.

FxAI is part of the AI Photo Journey family of AI creativity apps (https://ai-photo-journey.com).

## Key pages

- [Home](https://fxai.app/): What FxAI does and why people love it
- [Features](https://fxai.app/features): Overview of the four tools
- [AI Retouch](https://fxai.app/features/retouch): One-tap portrait enhancement
- [Photo Restore](https://fxai.app/features/restore): Repair and colorize old photos
- [AI Edit](https://fxai.app/features/edit): Edit photos by describing the change
- [AI Erase](https://fxai.app/features/erase): Remove unwanted objects
- [Restoration Guide](https://fxai.app/restoration-guide): How to restore old photos on iPhone
- [Use Cases](https://fxai.app/use-cases): Who uses FxAI and for what
- [FAQ](https://fxai.app/faq): Common questions, Pro, privacy, and billing
- [About](https://fxai.app/about): The team and the AI Photo Journey family

## Facts

- Platform: iOS (iPhone and iPad), download at https://apps.apple.com/us/app/ai-photo-enhancer-fxai/id6752206851
- No account or login required
- Free tier with watermark; Pro removes watermark and limits
- Sibling apps: Photix (https://photix.app), Videx (https://videx.app), SwapTo (https://swapto.app), PicAlive (https://picalive.app)
